body:
Good catch, and it holds against what this branch does: the PR moves three classes but the selection test only samples two, so a typo in either of the `LiveNutshellPaymentUITests` lines would still have gone green — the class either silently stops running anywhere, or runs in both shards and hands ~200s straight back to `ui-other`, which is the timeout this PR exists to fix.

It's moot now though: #464 landed the same split on 29 Oct as `ui-live-payments`, so this branch is superseded (and conflicted).

Main also solves it structurally rather than by sampling — both shards are generated from a single `LIVE_PAYMENT_CLASSES` array, so the `-only-testing`/`-skip-testing` pairs can't drift apart. It covers five live classes including `LiveNutshellPaymentUITests`, and the selection test samples all five.

Closing: superseded by #464, which landed the same split on 29 Oct as `ui-live-payments` and covers five live classes instead of three. It also drives both shards from one `LIVE_PAYMENT_CLASSES` array, so the `-only-testing`/`-skip-testing` pairs can't drift apart — which answers the review point here structurally rather than by adding another sampled class to the selection test.

Nothing from this branch is left unmerged: the workflow matrix, the shard routing, the `check_coverage.py` JSON list and the selection test are all on main.
